display.purpose: The page statement, one per page. Schibsted Grotesk at 800, set tight (-0.02em, line-height 0.98), always sentence case.

h1.purpose: Major section statements. Same heavy display voice via the .display class.

h2.purpose: Section headings, closing CTA statements, the big sign headline.

h3.purpose: Item names, FAQ questions, form success headlines.

body-lg.purpose: The fog-colored supporting paragraph directly under a display heading.

body.purpose: Running text, capped around 36rem. Fog for support, lamp for content.

label.purpose: The small semibold caps voice (600, 0.08em): nav, buttons, form labels, filter tabs, sign sublines. The only uppercase in the system.

shadows.name: deep
shadows.purpose: The .window-photo treatment. Seats gallery photographs in the dark; used under photographs only, never UI chrome.

shadows.name: neon-box-glow
shadows.purpose: The lit sign's tube emission, paired with a 1.5px neon border.

shadows.name: btn-glow-hover
shadows.purpose: Primary green actions borrow the tube glow on hover (250ms ease). Rest state has no shadow.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default ease for settle, rise, FAQ open, and the faq-mark rotation.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Hero photo settling on arrival, once.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Text rise: hero lines staggered 350/550/750ms via inline animationDelay, and revealed captions (.rise-go).

motion.name: mask-open
motion.purpose: One-time photo reveal on scroll; clip lives on an inner wrapper, never the observed element (Chromium IntersectionObserver caveat).

motion.name: neon-on
motion.purpose: The sign flickering on, once per mount; NeonSign re-runs it on tap via a key bump.

motion.name: neon-buzz
motion.purpose: The subtle opacity hum of the lit sign. The only looping animation, on the live sign only.

motion.name: drift
motion.purpose: Scroll-driven vertical drift on the lamp-wall photo, gated behind @supports (animation-timeline: view()).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce collapses all of the above
motion.purpose: Every animation removed with content fully visible: opacity 1, clip removed, transitions off.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The green door. Says what happens; glows like the sign on hover; night text always.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 28px; background: var(--color-lq-green, #6bb22e); color: var(--color-night, #131311); border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 250ms ease, background-color 250ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-lq-press, #7ec93c); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgb(107 178 46 / 0.45), 0 0 32px rgb(107 178 46 / 0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-lamp, #f4f2ec); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The second door beside every green one. Lamp border at 60%, full on hover, no glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 28px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-lamp, #f4f2ec); border: 1px solid rgb(244 242 236 / 0.6); border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 200ms ease, background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--color-lamp, #f4f2ec); background: var(--color-night-2, #1b1b18); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-lamp, #f4f2ec); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Night-2 fill on hairline night-3, green caret, fog placeholder.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 48px; width: 100%; max-width: 20rem; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--color-night-2, #1b1b18); color: var(--color-lamp, #f4f2ec); border: 1px solid var(--color-night-3, #2b2b26); border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; caret-color: var(--color-lq-green, #6bb22e); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-fog, #a3a094); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-lamp, #f4f2ec); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter Tab
components.description: Nav links and floor filters share it: label voice, 2px underline, live count from data on the floor board.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 24px; background: var(--color-night, #131311); padding: 8px 4px; } .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding-top: 2px; background: none; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: var(--color-fog, #a3a094); font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--color-lamp, #f4f2ec); } .ds-tab-active { border-bottom-color: var(--color-lq-green, #6bb22e); color: var(--color-lamp, #f4f2ec); } .ds-tab-count { color: var(--color-lq-press, #7ec93c); } .ds-tab-count-idle { color: rgb(163 160 148 / 0.7); }

components.name: Neon Sign (lit)
components.description: The live sign while the store is open: glowing tube box, flicker-on, endless faint buzz. A tappable button that re-flickers on tap.
components.css: .ds-sign-lit { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 16px 20px; background: rgb(19 19 17 / 0.8); border: 1.5px solid var(--color-neon, #8ade4a); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgb(107 178 46 / 0.35), inset 0 0 10px rgb(107 178 46 / 0.2); color: var(--color-neon, #8ade4a); text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgb(138 222 74 / 0.55), 0 0 24px rgb(107 178 46 / 0.4); cursor: pointer; animation: ds-buzz 6s 2200ms linear infinite; } .ds-sign-head { font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1; } .ds-sign-sub { font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } @keyframes ds-buzz { 0%, 92%, 94%, 98%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 93% { opacity: 0.93; } 97% { opacity: 0.96; } }

components.name: Neon Sign (dark)
components.description: The same sign after hours: tubes off, fog at reduced alpha, next lighting-up time underneath.
components.css: .ds-sign-dark { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 16px 20px; background: rgb(19 19 17 / 0.8); border: 1.5px solid rgb(163 160 148 / 0.35); border-radius: 10px; color: rgb(163 160 148 / 0.75); cursor: pointer; } .ds-sign-dark-head { font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1; } .ds-sign-dark-sub { font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.8; }

components.name: FAQ Item
components.description: Native details/summary in a hairline stack; body opens via the 0fr-to-1fr grid trick, the + mark rotates 45 degrees.
components.html:
Is the tag price the price?+

Yes. The tag price is the price, and everything on the floor is priced to leave.
components.css: .ds-faq { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-night-3, #2b2b26); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-night-3, #2b2b26); background: var(--color-night, #131311); } .ds-faq-q { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; min-height: 48px; padding: 20px 0; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; color: var(--color-lamp, #f4f2ec); font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-faq-q::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-faq-q:hover { color: var(--color-lq-press, #7ec93c); } .ds-faq-mark { color: var(--color-fog, #a3a094); line-height: 1; transition: transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-faq[open] .ds-faq-mark { transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-faq-body { display: grid; grid-template-rows: 0fr; transition: grid-template-rows 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-faq[open] .ds-faq-body { grid-template-rows: 1fr; } .ds-faq-body > div { overflow: hidden; } .ds-faq-a { padding-bottom: 24px; margin: 0; color: var(--color-fog, #a3a094); font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.65; }

components.name: Success Panel
components.description: The done/error surface: night-2 fill, hairline border, display headline, plain words. No shadow, no icon, no red.
components.html:
You're on the list

Watch for a text from us. Reply STOP any time and we stop.
components.css: .ds-panel { max-width: 28rem; padding: 28px; background: var(--color-night-2, #1b1b18); border: 1px solid var(--color-night-3, #2b2b26); } .ds-panel-head { margin: 0; color: var(--color-lamp, #f4f2ec); font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-panel-body { margin: 12px 0 0; color: var(--color-fog, #a3a094); font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.65; }

narrative.northStar: The lit sign on a clean shop
narrative.overview:
The site is a clean, fast, obviously professional shop at night with one working neon sign burning on the wall. The field is crisp flat charcoal structured by hairlines; the text is lamp and fog; the merchandise is real floor photographs seated in deep shadow; and all of the character lives in the sign system: a live open/closed sign that knows the store clock, hums while the store is open, and re-flickers when you tap it, static neon signs leading page headers, a drawn tube arrow pointing at the signup form, and a tube glow that primary buttons borrow on hover. The fixtures are interactive by client demand: FAQ accordions, a floor lightbox, live filter counts, a today-lit hours table.

This world is a client-pinned refinement of the previous "showroom at night" rendition (direction rolls e1b2fdb5 and 6e5352b2 are retained for the world lineage and the floor-board structure). The client pinned four words: neon vibe, clean and professional, character, interactive. The palette token set carried over unchanged, but the atmosphere changed: the radial lamp pools are gone, the Caslon serif voice is gone, and the room is now crisp and flat with a single grotesk family doing every job.
keyCharacteristics: Crisp flat charcoal field with hairline night-3 structure; no atmospheric pools, no washes
One family, Schibsted Grotesk (variable, with italic): heavy tight display in sentence case, regular body, small semibold caps labels
A working neon sign system is the character: the live tappable sign, static signs, the tube arrow, glow on primary green actions
Photographs presented as lit displays: square-cornered, deep soft shadows, brightness lift on hover
Interactive fixtures built on native elements: details/summary FAQs, a dialog lightbox, data-driven filter counts, a Central-time clock
Rural-4G light: no animation/UI/icon libraries, real floor photos only

rules.name: The Night Text Rule
rules.body: Green surfaces always carry night text, never white. White on LQ green fails contrast; night on LQ green passes. No exceptions on any surface.

rules.name: The Sign System Rule
rules.body: Neon is a lit object from the store's world, never a decorative accent. The device family is closed: the live NeonSign (lit during store hours, tubes dark via neon-dim with the next lighting-up time when closed), static header signs, the drawn tube arrow, and the btn-glow hover glow on green primary actions. One primary sign per page; the arrow may accompany it. Neon text or borders on things that are not signs are defects.

rules.name: The Flat Charcoal Rule
rules.body: The field is crisp, flat #131311 with hairline structure. No radial lamp pools, no ambient washes, no decorative gradients. The only gradients in the system are the scrims over hero photographs, which exist to keep text legible, not to decorate.

rules.name: The Dark Band Rule
rules.body: Hero photographs get a two-layer night scrim (a radial vignette plus a bottom linear ramp). The scrim geometry must keep the band behind the mobile headline dark enough that lamp text stays legible over any photo. Re-check whenever the hero photo or scrim stops change.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: The display voice is always sentence case, never uppercase. Uppercase belongs exclusively to the 12px semibold tracked .label voice.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow or kicker labels above headings. The one element that may sit above a page's H1 is a neon sign, and it is a lit object from the store's world, not a category label.

rules.name: The Window Display Rule
rules.body: Shadows exist to present merchandise; glow exists to mark signs and the actions that matter. Buttons at rest, inputs, panels, the header, and the lightbox cast nothing; a shadowed card or dropdown is out of world. Hard offset shadows do not exist here.

dos: Do put night text (#131311) on every green surface, per The Night Text Rule.
Do keep the field flat crisp charcoal with hairline night-3 structure; the character belongs to the sign system, not to washes.
Do give every tap target 48px minimum height and 8px minimum spacing, with the global lamp focus ring intact.

Do use the store's own words and real floor photographs: "Limited Quantities + Unlimited Savings", tag-price language, photos from the LQ floor only. No stock, no AI imagery, no fabricated testimonials.
Do write buttons that say what happens, in plain speech: "Walk the floor", "Get directions", "Call (662) 841-5959".
Do keep the TCPA consent language verbatim from src/lib/consent.ts wherever an SMS opt-in appears; it is regulated content. Any change goes through legal review and bumps SMS_CONSENT_VERSION.
Do keep FAQ answers inside verified store facts, per the header contract in src/lib/faq.ts; no operational claims LQ hasn't confirmed.
Do keep the hero scrim dark behind the mobile headline band (The Dark Band Rule) and re-check it when photos change.
Do render clock-driven components (NeonSign, OpenNow, HoursTable) neutral before hydration, on America/Chicago time, reserved so nothing shifts.
Do collapse every animation under prefers-reduced-motion with the content left fully visible.
Do end every page at one of the two doors: join the text list, or call/visit/finance in person.
donts: Don't imply anything can be bought online. No prices on the site (prices live on the tags), no carts, no "shop" or "buy" language. The footer's closing line is doctrine: the store is the store.
Don't reintroduce the radial lamp pools or any decorative gradient; the photo scrims are the only gradients. The prior serif rendition is retired, not dormant.
Don't put neon (#8ade4a) on anything that is not a sign device, and don't give more than one primary sign to a page. The btn-glow hover is the only neon the buttons get.
Don't set the display voice in uppercase, and don't add eyebrow/kicker labels above headings; only a neon sign may lead an H1.

Don't use em dashes or marketing filler (elevate, curated, seamless, transform, unlock, discover), and don't make unverified operational claims. Urgency must be factual: limited quantities is true, so say it plainly.
Don't treat the sold flags in src/lib/floor.ts as live inventory; they are placeholder demonstration data pending the client's real board.
Don't round structural corners or shadow UI chrome; 6px is for controls, the deep shadow is for photographs, glow is for signs.
Don't add runtime dependencies (animation, UI, icon, or state libraries); rural 4G is the baseline.
